lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixed the reviewer's round-2 finding on README.md's Security section (lines 301-315): the disclosure named the risk for BOTH session kinds ('every worker and orchestrator session runs with no permission prompt') but the offered mitigation (`[loop] worker_isolation = "container"`) only actually covers the worker/reviewer dispatch path (readWorkerIsolation, read from src/commands/sidecar.ts's worker/reviewer dispatch call sites, via src/config/models.ts:466), while the orchestrator pane is always spawned on the host with `claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions` (src/commands/setup.ts, both the fresh-session spawn and the rehydrate spawn), unconditionally, regardless of worker_isolation. A reader who set container mode after reading the old sentence would wrongly believe the host was fully protected. Fixed by appending 3 sentences immediately after the existing mitigation sentence in the same paragraph (not a new section): (1) names that the mitigation is partial and scoped to worker/reviewer dispatch only, citing the exact source (sidecar.ts's dispatch path + readWorkerIsolation in models.ts); (2) states the orchestrator pane is always spawned on host with bypassPermissions via setup.ts regardless of the setting; (3) states the residual: the long-lived orchestrator retains unrestricted host read/write/execute reach even in container mode. Verified all cited call sites by grep before writing (setup.ts:480 fresh-spawn and :561 rehydrate-spawn both hardcode `claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions` with no worker_isolation branch; sidecar.ts:1450/:2231/:2597/:2945/:3573 are the only readWorkerIsolation call sites and all are inside worker/reviewer/meta-loop dispatch functions, never the orchestrator spawn). Deliberately did NOT add exact line-number citations inline in the prose (unlike the reviewer's own finding note) since line numbers drift; named files and function/config-key identifiers instead, which is the existing citation style used elsewhere in this same README section. bun test: 5763 pass / 0 fail. bun run check:all: all gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code/knip, dup/jscpd, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet); the check:all run also surfaced pre-existing unrelated warnings (git push-to-main rejected because this sandboxed checkout has no 'origin' remote, an 'unknown pattern record' recordId warning, and 'suggestions.jsonl missing on main') that are environment artifacts of the sandboxed worktree, not caused by or related to this story's edit, and were not investigated further since they are out of this story's scope (a README prose fix).
